scientific_integrity: The proof separates the source-supplied D-set/tree and automorphism-group facts from the derived enumeration, and the derived counts are replayed by an exhaustive labelled-tree generator.
scientific_limitations: The constrained phylogenetic-tree enumeration is classical in nature; novelty is claimed only for the exact bridge to the 4-branching homogeneous D-set/N4 automorphism orbit profile. An unindexed prior observation remains possible.
title: Exact tuple-orbit profile of the homogeneous 4-branching D-set
